messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT CREATED · High 5xx/error rate detected on control plane -> edge for multiple endpoints: /v1/chat/completions, /v1/embeddings, and /v1/rerank. Auto-threshold triggered. Estimated customer impact: increased latency and 10% error rate for some routes. Pager: emma (oncall)
emma (oncall): ack. pulling up dashboards now. calling a quick triage. @raj can you join? :phone:
raj (eng-sre): on my way. I see bursts from a small set of API keys, mostly embeddings heavy. Errors look like upstream timeouts from the model pool + some overload on the gateway.
maya (support): getting PMs from a few customers saying embedding requests are timing out. Tier: mostly free & dev accounts but one paid client reporting production impact.
olivia (product): noted. if paid client affected, we should prioritize mitigation. any quick mitigations?
emma (oncall): plan: 1) immediate per-route quota reduction for embeddings and chat for non-paid tiers 2) add stricter route-specific rate limit for /v1/embeddings 3) disable rerank for free tier as temporary fallback 4) keep dedicated routes for enterprise untouched for now. executing now.
raj (eng-sre): preparing commands. we have two control knobs: edge rate limiter (envoy) and internal quota service (redctl). I'll patch quotas first to reduce blast radius.
li (infra): heads up — envoys are config-pushed from global xds; redctl applies faster for per-customer quotas.
raj (eng-sre): running:```bash
# reduce global per-route tokens for embeddings and chat (soft)
redctl quota update --route "/v1/embeddings" --default-rate 40rps --burst 80 --scope free,dev
redctl quota update --route "/v1/chat/completions" --default-rate 60rps --burst 120 --scope free,dev
# disable rerank on free tier
redctl feature-flag set rerank --scope free --value false
```
emma (oncall): executing redctl now. will monitor.
deploy-bot: deploy started for command redctl-quota-patch by raj at 2025-10-24T21:36:10Z
raj (eng-sre): done, changes rolled. watching metrics. initial drop in traffic to embeddings ~55%. error rate dropping but latency still elevated.
maya (support): updated customers: small notice to devs -> "We are throttling rates for free/dev tiers while we investigate; paid customers unaffected unless explicitly notified." Sent to top 10 impacted.
olivia (product): can we make route-specific limits even stricter for rerank (heavy CPU) while we stabilize? maybe route-based per-account cap of 5rps for non-enterprise.
raj (eng-sre): adding additional rule via envoy rate-limiter to prevent single keys from spiking:```json
{"route": "/v1/rerank","limit":5,"scope":"global_non_enterprise","mode":"reject"}
```
li (infra): I'm queuing an XDS push to edge to enforce the per-route reject rule. ETA ~20s.
emma (oncall): also enabling traffic-shaping fallback: less expensive model variants for high-QPS keys (auto-fallback). setting policy: route->fallback-model low-cost for embeddings.
raj (eng-sre): made a temporary mapping:```yaml
fallback_policies:
  - route: "/v1/embeddings"
    condition: "key.qps > 30"
    action: "route_to: small-embed-quantized"
```
deploy-bot: envoy xds push queued by li at 2025-10-24T21:37:02Z
deploy-bot: envoy xds push completed at 2025-10-24T21:37:25Z
raj (eng-sre): XDS applied. I'm seeing failed spikes get rejected at the gateway for rerank non-enterprise keys and embeddings fallback is routing ~18% of requests to quantized models. overall error rate back to baseline for chat, embeddings errors down to 2.3%.
maya (support): one enterprise customer reported intermittent errors earlier but not after our changes. I flagged them as "priority follow-up" to ensure they see the postmortem.
olivia (product): good. can we snapshot the key offenders for follow-up rate-limiting per-customer? We should escalate to Account for potential billing mitigation.
raj (eng-sre): exporting top offenders:```text
Top 5 API keys by QPS last 10min:
- key_abc123 (dev) 72rps -> throttled to 30rps
- key_xyz789 (paid) 48rps -> unaffected (enterprise) but routed to fallback model
- key_mno456 (dev) 40rps -> throttled
- key_lmn000 (bot) 90rps -> blocked by envoy
- key_pq9 (paid) 20rps -> ok
```
maya (support): I created ticket SUP-8931 to follow up with the paid customer. copying account manager.
emma (oncall): Incident severity: sev2 -> due to partial customer impact but mitigations in place. Timeline to write in incident tracker: initial detection 21:36:10Z, redctl quotas applied 21:36:38Z, envoy rules applied 21:37:25Z, metrics normalized 21:41:00Z.
olivia (product): action items: - product to propose rate-limit defaults and fallback model policy - growth/eng to consider softer limits for free tier - account team to reach out to affected paid customer - SRE to post postmortem with config diffs.
raj (eng-sre): adding follow-ups: persist throttle rules for 24h, gather kube/serving logs for the model pool to see if model backend timeouts were root cause.
li (infra): I'll capture xds snapshots and envoy metrics.
maya (support): will send an update to impacted customers in 30min.
emma (oncall): handoff: I'm going offline in 20min for oncall rotation. @raj take lead for the next 6h, please. I'll update the incident channel and create the formal postmortem doc.
raj (eng-sre): taking it. will keep monitoring dashboards and escalate if error rate climbs past 3%.
emma (oncall): thanks everyone. closing real-time mitigation loop. leaving notes for postmortem: consider per-route quota defaults, per-API-key burst caps, and auto-fallback by cost class.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATED · status: mitigated -> monitoring. assignee: raj. severity: sev2 -> 2025-10-24T21:43:38Z
